title: Bound remote mailbox page wake-state reservation work once per page
outcome: Avoid recomputing the bounded remote wake reservation prefix separately for each message on a mailbox read page. Compute one coherent bounded reservation/status view per page or equivalent bounded reuse, preserving current authority and append semantics.
acceptance: A mailbox page with many pending remote wakes computes the reservation view once or with demonstrably bounded shared work; status and capacity causes remain correct under concurrent settlement. Regression coverage discriminates per-message reservation amplification.
The exact-input full gate passes with an independent read-only review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
